integrity: The universal statement rests on a self-contained analytic proof; exact rational tests are supplementary. No authorship, independent validation, or publication certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The identity concerns exactly all planar convex quadrilaterals and their triangular limits. It does not assert a general-polygon or general-convex-body identity; possible unindexed historical overlap remains.
title: The maximal-triangle formula for reflected mixed area of convex quadrilaterals
